Weather Summary / Alert :
As per the forecast from RMC Mumbai, Thundershower along with light rainfall may occur at isolated places in Beed District on dated 26th July. Light to
moderate rainfall may occur at isolated places in Beed District on dated 24th July. Light rainfall may occur at scattered places on dated 24th & 25th July & at

moderate rainfall may occur at isolated places in Beed District on dated 24th July. Light rainfall may occur at scattered places on dated 24th & 25th July & at
isolated places during 26th to 28th July in Beed District. Gradual rise in maximum temperature by 2 to 3 OC during next four to five days in Beed District.
General Advisory :
As per ERFS products Rainfall may be below normal, maximum temperature & minimum temperature may be Normal during 24th to 30th July 2026 & Rainfall
may be below normal, maximum temperature may be Normal to slightly above Normal & minimum temperature mey be slightly above Normal during 31st July to
06th August 2026.

SMS Advisory: The areas where sowing is not completed sowing of Sunflower, Pigeonpea, Hybrid Pearl millet, Soybean Pigeonpea (4:2), Pearl millet + Pigeonpea
(3:3), Caster, Niger and Sesamum should be done after receipt of (75 to 100 mm) rainfall.
Name of Crop Stage Agromet Advisory
Soybean Growth Intercultural operation should be done for weed management in soybean crop. If infestation of leaf eating catter piller &
stem borer may observed in soybean crop, For management take a spray of any one chemical as given below Profenofos
50% @ 400 ml or Ethion 50% @ 600 ml or Thimethoxam 12.6% + Lambda Cyhalothrin 9.5% @ 50 ml or if incidence is
more take a spray of Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% @ 60 ml per acre during clear weather condition. If yellow leaf observed
in soybean crop due to micronutrient deficiency for management take a spray of EDTA Chilated mix Micronutrients
grade-2 @ 50 g or 50 ml with 19:19:19 @ 100 g per 10 liter of water during clear weather condition. If infestatin of yellow

grade-2 @ 50 g or 50 ml with 19:19:19 @ 100 g per 10 liter of water during clear weather condition. If infestatin of yellow
mosaic observed in soybean crop for management, Remove and destroy yellow mosaic infected plants.
Kharif sorghum Growth Intercultural operation should be done for weed management in kharif sorghum crop. For management of fall armyworm
in kharif sorghumcrop take a spray of Emamectine Benzoate 5 % @ 4 g or Spinetoram 11.7 SC @ 4 ml per 10 liter of
water during clear weather condition.
Pearl millet Growth Light hoeing should be done in pearl millet crop for weed management and for soil moisture conservation. Light hoeing
should be done in soybean crop for weed management and for soil moisture conservation.
Sugarcane Vegetative Due to cloudy weather, an infestation of the 'Payrila' (moth) pest is being observed in the sugarcane crop. To monitor the
Growth pest and to trap and destroy large numbers of adult moths, a light trap should be installed at a height of six inches above
the crop canopy—at a ratio of one trap per five acres—and operated between 6:00 PM and 10:00 PM. For management,

for chemical control, take a spray Chlorpyrifos 20% @ 600 ml or Monocrotophos 36% @ 200 ml of per acre during clear
weather condition.
Turmeric Growth For management of Rhizome fly in turmeric take a spray of Quinalphos 25 % @ 20 ml or Diamethoate 30 % @ 10 ml per
10 liter of water with an interval of 15 days during clear weather condition. (As label claim was not given by Central
Insecticides Board for Rhizome fly in turmeric the research recommendation of university is mentioned here).
Intercultural operations should be done for weed management in turmeric crop during wapsa condition.
Citrus Growth As the *Mrig Bahar* orange and sweet lime orchards are currently in the flowering & Fruit Initiation stage, do not spray
any insecticide in Mrug bahar citrus orchard. Intercultural operations should be done for weed management in citrus
orchard.

any insecticide in Mrug bahar citrus orchard. Intercultural operations should be done for weed management in citrus
orchard.
Pomegranate Growth As the *Mrig Bahar* pomegranate orchards Given the possibility of a disease outbreak in the orchard, spray a 1%
Bordeaux mixture during clear weather condition. Intercultural operations should be done for weed management in
pomegranate orchard.
Sapota Growth Intercultural operations should be done for weed management in Sapota orchard.
Vegetable Transplanting/ If sufficient moisture is available in soil sowing of direct sown vegetable crops (i.e. by seeds) for example Okra, Bitter
Harvesting gourd, Ridge gourd, Pumpkin can be done. Transplanting of 45 days old seedlings of vegetable crops (Brinjal, Tomato,
Chilli etc.) should be done at the places where rainfall was received by considering soil moisture. Harvesting of mature
vegetable crops should be done. Weed management should be done in vegetable crops.
Floriculture Transplanting/ Transplanting of Floriculture crops should be done at the places where rainfall was received by considering soil moisture.

Floriculture Transplanting/ Transplanting of Floriculture crops should be done at the places where rainfall was received by considering soil moisture.
Harvesting Harvesting of mature flowers should be done. Weed management should be done in floricultural crops.
Animal -- During the monsoon season, the prevalence of stable flies, mosquitoes, and ticks around livestock increases; therefore, as
husbandry per advice of veternary doctor spray the insecticides. Livestock should be vaccinated against monsoon-related diseases as
recommended by a veternary doctor. In particular, goats and sheep should be vaccinated against enterotoxaemia at the
appropriate time to prevent the disease during the monsoon. During monsoon season, avoid feeding livestock excessive
amounts of tender, green fodder.
